'''Atorra''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Atorra system/Legends|Atorra system]]. It was situated in the [[Back Reach]] area of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]], within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The planet was connected by the [[Ardan Cross]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Troos system/Legends|Troos]] and the [[Chenowei system/Legends|Chenowei systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

At some point, members of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[B'trillan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] immigrated to Atorra, giving rise to a sparsely populated [[Agriworld/Legends|agricultural colony]]. By<ref name="TEA" /> [[43 ABY]],<ref name="date">The main section of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which includes a description of Atorra, ends with a mention of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]]'s journey across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the beginning of which is depicted in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''. The events of that novel are dated to [[43 ABY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> however, [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of [[Water/Legends|drought]] had ruined the colony. By that [[Time/Legends|time]], it was rumored that an ancient battle had resulted in the crash-landing of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in Atorra's [[Desert/Legends|badlands]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Atorra was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] and which placed the planet in grid square Q-5.<ref name="TEA" />
